objectiveReports.title: Objective reports
objectiveReports.lead: Measure FOA's six-month objectives using retained operational records and dated social-media observations.
objectiveReports.socialLead: Record aggregate numbers supplied by FOA's social channels. Compare observations by date; no social account connection or tracking is used.
objectiveReports.invalidPeriod: Choose valid start and end dates, with the start on or before the end.
objectiveReports.downloadHint: The CSV contains all seven objective sections as aggregate data only.
objectiveReports.socialDownloadHint: The CSV contains aggregate channel observations for the selected dates.
objectiveReports.retention: Reports reflect records retained today, not a historical database snapshot. Erasure, retention, cancellations and later approvals can change earlier-period totals.

definitions.participation: Currently confirmed registrations in non-cancelled competitions, dated by confirmation. Unique participant profiles are counted once overall and once per route, so the route counts need not add to the overall count.
definitions.engagement: Achieved ladder milestones within the period (the first three per competition; later ones once per person), first club approvals, distinct members joining clubs, completed events and campaigns by start date, and actual check-ins by attendance date.
definitions.partnerships: Currently verified institutions originally verified during the period. Pending, rejected and suspended institutions do not count.
definitions.volunteers: Approved service only, dated by the IST day worked, not approval date. Each volunteer is counted once regardless of number of tasks.
definitions.donations: Accepted domestic INR donations captured during the period, minus refunds completed during the period, even if the gift was received earlier. Fees, auction proceeds, pending payments, duplicate returns and refused foreign or late recurring payments are excluded.
definitions.feedback: Surveys and retained eligible invitations by send date; actual responses by answer date. Responses may belong to earlier survey cohorts, so these independent totals are not a response rate.
definitions.social: Each observation records a channel's reported counts on an IST calendar day. Follower change compares with its previous recorded observation, including one before the period. Missing counts or baseline show a dash, never zero. Reach is not summed across overlapping audiences or time windows.

objectiveReports.socialEmpty: No social observations were recorded for these dates.
objectiveReports.recordHint: Use the aggregate counts from the channel's own dashboard for the reported observation date. Use the same measurement window each time so observations are comparable. Followers and posts are required. Leave unavailable counts blank. Saving a channel and date that already exist corrects that observation.
objectiveReports.unchanged: This exact observation is already recorded
objectiveReports.invalidInput: Enter a channel, a valid observation date no later than today, and non-negative whole-number counts.
objectiveReports.forbidden: Your role does not permit recording observations.
